about.hero.title: Our Story
about.hero.subtitle: Along was born in Lagos, built for the millions of daily commuters navigating West Africa's most dynamic cities. We turn shared experience into reliable route intelligence.
about.why.title: Why Along

about.feature.communityDesc: Every route is posted, validated, and rated by real commuters. No algorithms — just people sharing what they know.
